name: phasefinder
description: PhaseFinder is a browser-based tool for inspecting and plotting flow cytometry `.fcs` files. It is designed as a lightweight, local-first workspace: users drop FCS files into the page, the app reads the FCS header and TEXT metadata in the browser, and selected samples can then be loaded into an overlaid DNA-content event histogram with optional Dean–Jett–Fox cell-cycle modeling.

scripts.check:base: BASE_PATH=/phasefinder/ vite build --outDir dist-base --emptyOutDir && DIST_DIR=dist-base npm run provenance && BASE_PATH=/phasefinder/ DIST_DIR=dist-base npm run check:dist
scripts.check: npm run preflight && npm run check:dom && npm run check:privacy && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:dist && npm run check:privacy
